content.text:
I added a nesting limit to the parser in `core/license_expr.py`. I haven't run anything, so this is checked by reading the code only.

A license expression can now nest parentheses up to 64 levels. One level deeper raises a new `NestingError`, which says "expression nested too deeply (more than 64 levels of parentheses)". It is a kind of `ParseError`, so `decide` handles it as before and gives that component `Needs review` with that message in its reason. The rest of the SBOM review carries on.

`core/decide.py` needed no change. Expressions within the limit are parsed and decided exactly as before, so `OR`, `AND` and the handling of unparseable input are unchanged.
